scope: One local user-reported recording; not a dataset-wide DER benchmark.
surrounding_turn_replay: Question and closing acknowledgement assigned to first voice; short answer assigned to second voice.
timing_scope: Boundary pass includes decoding and local DTW, reuses previously completed acoustic evidence; model initialization and original ASR excluded. Single device runs.
privacy: Audio, transcript, database and acoustic vectors stay local and are excluded from this change.
limitations: Local re-decode supplies timing only; original transcript characters are retained.
A joined local word can be mapped to 2–3 uniquely matching saved words; internal times are interpolated within the DTW span.
Ambiguous matches, low confidence, simultaneous speech and ordering conflicts remain unresolved rather than forcing a speaker.
No proof of general DER improvement or memory/performance on other phones.
Diagnostic APK uses preinstalled models; this change does not produce standalone LIGHT/HEAVY bundles.
